purpose: Certify exact static composition of already certified primitives and the additional binding driver, without changing mathematical, temporal, missingness or scientific meaning.
authority_assessment: D084 and research-contract/1.0 section 14.1 permit deterministic conformance of existing certified primitives under unchanged semantics. The current implementation covers static binding/compilation only; existing outcome-review, data, exposure, calibration, allocation and freeze requirements remain separate.

independent_fixture.authorship_qualification: The reviewer had inspected the existing binding implementation before authoring these cases. Expected metadata and grid/window arithmetic were derived from the existing specifications without calling a calculator or compiler. Standard-library JSON hashing and UTC date formatting bind the declared inputs only. This was not a blind implementation review.

findings.finding: Existing compilation is transport-bound but is not, by itself, an independent driver certificate.
findings.evidence: The separate fixed oracle compares all eleven result fields, including per-program type/unit/ref/parameter metadata, warmup, row bounds and exact input/request identities. Existing primitive conformance remains separately bound.

findings.finding: The new conformance check catches plausible, internally consistent false compile metadata.
findings.evidence: Independent adversarial tests construct underreported warmup with consistent row bounds, swapped program-specific feature closures with an unchanged global union, and a plausible false parameter pointer. Each passes the intentionally limited transport check and fails the new fixed expectation check.

findings.finding: A retained source package and input capsule precede validation; the certificate binds the exact existing compilation and dependencies.
findings.evidence: Reviewed owned compiled-ID, reference-package, feature-certificate, source/runtime and hash checks. The actual candidate is recomputed only after fixed driver checks; this exact replay is binding evidence rather than a replacement oracle.

findings.finding: The certificate adds only composition-conformance evidence and cannot be self-issued through worker or generic source APIs.
findings.evidence: Protected namespaces and operator-only operations are exercised. Independent worker tests reject before any artifact access. Full integration binds actual synthetic registries and denies changed compiled controls.

findings.finding: Current inspection is separated from immutable historical records and exact dependency revocation.
findings.evidence: Full integration reopens the composition gate on revocation, preserves the original plan/certificate, blocks re-use of the revoked validator, and retains interrupted/cancelled attempts. The final installed-file guard also reopens the gate when validator or fixture bytes change after process import.

findings.finding: Plan preparation retains historical prerequisite snapshots and current inspection closes only the composition gate when warranted.
findings.evidence: Raw policy output remains unchanged; composition_at_preparation retains the historical result. Current remaining gates are derived separately. Existing semantic/data/calibration/allocation/freeze and scientific_readiness=false boundaries remain.

findings.finding: Compilation conformance does not grant market-outcome or calibration access.
findings.evidence: The owned integration successfully checks composition with the market-row loader forbidden. Existing protected-input ancestry, reference ownership and source integrity checks remain; hashing retained source blobs is not a new outcome-evaluation permission.

independent_checks.provenance: Independent reviewer ran six adversarial cases on the final guarded source.
Independent reviewer ran five focused cases, including the installed-file currency counterexample and an actual isolated child with a corrupted driver.

independently_inspected_parent_checks.provenance: Final complete 21-case composition suite, including ten real binding/retention/revocation cases; read exact structured exit and retained output.
Fourteen plan-review regressions; ran before the last installed-file currency guard.
Eleven plan-retention regressions; ran before the last installed-file currency guard.
Eighteen revocation regressions; ran before the last installed-file currency guard.

counting_qualification: This step has 64 distinct unittest cases: 21 composition and 43 targeted regressions. Eleven independently rerun focused/adversarial cases are already contained in the 21 and are not added again. The 26 fixed compiler fixtures are nested conformance cases, not 26 additional unittest methods. This is not a full repository-suite claim.

retained_failed_observations.classification: Test helper attempted unsupported Broker context-manager use; fixed explicit close/cleanup. This run did not establish namespace behavior.
Three namespace subtests failed before the new protected namespace registration; later checks exercise the implemented protection.

Eight cases passed; worker-authority case failed in its helper because op(name) collided with register_worker(name=...). Renamed only that helper argument, retained the original failure, and reran the full integration.
Two subcases remained CONFORMANT after on-disk bytes changed in the running process. Added installed-byte checks; the unchanged counterexamples pass in the final independent and complete suites.

limitations: The fixed bundle supplements rather than replaces existing 112 expression and 31 outcome expectations and feature certification. A finite passing suite does not prove absence of all bugs.
The exact-candidate recompilation uses the same checked implementation and is replay/binding evidence, not a second independent oracle or market-data source.
Fixture inputs are synthetic static compiler payloads. They are not admitted data snapshots, proof of original idea equivalence or a full end-to-end research result.
Existing outcome REVIEW_REQUIRED, partition, missingness and availability behavior is unchanged. A static composition certificate does not resolve those scientific or state-specific readiness gaps.
The installed-file currency unit fixture mocks dependency setup explicitly; actual ownership, runtime, retention and dependency behavior has separate complete synthetic integration coverage.
The isolated child retains existing bounded-process behavior; it is not an OS sandbox against a malicious account or trusted host.
No PIT truth, rights, unknown training exposure, calibrated inference, empirical evidence status, allocation/freeze or capital authority is established.
The reviewer did not rerun the expensive complete integration; its exact exit/output and implementation were inspected. No production source edits or paid model calls were performed by the reviewer.
next_action: Preserve and publish the fixed fixtures, source-bound certificate path and this evidence, then continue the existing scientific prerequisites without elevating composition conformance into general research readiness.
